description:
🎵 A Metronome You’ll Actually Love Using
Tack is more than just a metronome — it’s a sleek, highly customizable rhythm companion built for musicians who care about precision and aesthetics. Whether you’re practicing alone or performing live, Tack helps you stay in perfect time without distractions.
📱 On Your Phone — Powerful, Elegant, Thoughtful
• Beautiful beat visualization with changeable emphasizes and subdivisions
• Song library for saving and organizing metronome configurations
• Options for count-in, duration, incremental tempo change, muted beats and swing
• Settings for flash screen, volume, audio latency correction and elapsed time
• Support for dynamic color, dynamic contrast and large screens
• 100% ad-free — no analytics, no interruptions
⌚️ On Your Wrist — Best-in-Class for Wear OS
• Quick tempo changes with intuitive picker and a separate tap screen
• Advanced beat customization with changeable emphasizes and subdivisions
• Bookmarks for tempo, beats and subdivisions
• Settings for flash screen, volume and audio latency correction
🌍 Built with Musicians, for Musicians
Tack is open-source and community-driven. Found a bug or missing a feature? You’re welcome to contribute or report issues here: github.com/patzly/tack-android
Want to help translate Tack into your language? Join this project on Transifex: app.transifex.com/patzly/tack-android
